topic: Browne's OEIS A164660 floor-product conjecture and Chebyshev integral numerators
title: OEIS A164660, final FORMULA (29 May 2016): Chebyshev numerators and floor products

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Anthony Browne's conjecture in OEIS A164660, final FORMULA (29 May 2016): for every positive integer n, the reduced numerator of the integral from 0 to 1 of T_(n+1)(x) equals the stated floor product and (-1)^(n/rad(n)). Both sides are +1 exactly when 4 divides n. The same calculation proves the preceding rational-integral conjecture and gives its denominator sequence A164661. More generally, replacing the exponent n in the product by any integer r >= 2, and translating its interval by any integer, leaves the product unchanged. We give the exact root count for every r >= 1 and correct two coefficient-table discrepancies in the linked sources.
summary: A self-contained proof of the complete A164660 floor-product identity, with the integral and denominator formulas, the sharp general-exponent root count, translated-interval sign invariance, precise Lean coverage, and coefficient-source corrections. Earlier root-count formulas and Fried's proof of the A000188 square-indicator identity are credited.
